report.summary: 4 reviewed findings: ignore-rules-incomplete (high, narrowed), dry-run-gate-bypass (low, narrowed), missing-cross-module-cancellation-protocol (high, confirmed), reparse-escape (high, narrowed).
risks: IgnoreRules._hit fails for multi-segment unanchored directory patterns.
No integration test for cancellation propagation across modules.
TOCTOU window in worktree cleanup between reachability check and syscall.
todos: Add test for multi-segment unanchored directory pattern in ignore rules.
Add integration test for cancellation propagation from gate_candidates to runner.
Add re-verification before os.rmdir/os.unlink in worktree cleanup.
Document fragility of gate ordering in publish_to_pr.

items.title: Fix multi-segment unanchored directory pattern matching in IgnoreRules._hit
items.why_now: Current implementation fails to match patterns like 'a/b' against paths like 'a/b/c.py', causing directories to be incorrectly ignored. This is a correctness bug in a core path-matching function.

steps.do: Modify _hit to join candidate segments for dir_only patterns and compare against the full pattern using fnmatch.

items.assumption: The fix should join segments with '/' and match against the full pattern. Existing tests for single-segment patterns must still pass.

items.title: Add integration test for cancellation propagation from gate_candidates to runner
items.why_now: No test verifies that a cancel token passed to gate_candidates propagates through run_attempt to the actual runner. This could lead to hangs or unresponsive cancellation.

steps.do: Search for existing test that imports both gated_writes and attempt and calls gate_candidates with cancel token.
If no test found, write a test that creates a cancel token, calls gate_candidates with it, and verifies the runner stops within timeout.

items.assumption: The test file name is assumed; actual location may differ. The cancel token API is as described in daedalus/kairos/gated_writes.py and daedalus/spine/attempt.py.

items.title: Add re-verification before syscall in worktree cleanup to close TOCTOU window
items.why_now: There is a race between _verify_reachable and os.rmdir/os.unlink where an attacker with write access to the worktree could swap a junction, causing deletion outside the worktree.

steps.do: Add a call to _verify_reachable immediately before each os.rmdir and os.unlink in the cleanup loop.

items.assumption: The function _verify_reachable exists and can be called on the exact path. The TOCTOU window is small but closing it improves security.

items.title: Add test verifying gate runs even when dry_run=True in publish_to_pr
items.why_now: The call order dependency (screen_egress before dry_run check) is fragile and could be broken by future refactoring, potentially bypassing the egress gate.

steps.do: Add a test that calls publish_to_pr with dry_run=True and verifies that screen_egress was called (e.g., by mocking).

items.assumption: The test can mock screen_egress or inspect its side effects. The function is in daedalus/council/publish.py.
